---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")
#let pale-gold = rgb("#FFF8D6")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.27in, bottom: 0.42in, x: 0.44in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.5pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 10pt,
      [Technology Commons - Weekly Progress + Learning Skills],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
  size: 10pt,
  fill: charcoal,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.46em, justify: false)

#let write-line(stroke-color: slate) = line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.75pt + stroke-color)
#let check-box() = rect(width: 9.5pt, height: 9.5pt, stroke: 1pt + navy, radius: 1pt)

#let brand-header(title, subtitle) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 2.42in),
    column-gutter: 18pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 23pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: slate)[#subtitle]
    ],
    [
      #grid(
        columns: (0.54in, 1fr),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        align: horizon,
        [#image("technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.50in)],
        [
          #text(size: 8.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
          #linebreak()
          #text(size: 7.6pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
        ],
      )
    ],
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #line(length: 0.68in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.25pt + navy)
]

#let info-row() = [
  #grid(
    columns: (auto, 1.35fr, auto, 0.86fr, auto, 0.94fr),
    column-gutter: 6pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Course:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
  )
]

#let eval-item(label) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 4pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold", fill: charcoal)[#label]],
    [#check-box()]
  )
]

#let evaluation-panel() = [
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    fill: pale-gold,
    stroke: 0.7pt + mist,
    radius: 3pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 5pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 8.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[CHECK]
    #v(3pt)
    #eval-item([Neat])
    #v(3pt)
    #eval-item([Detailed])
    #v(3pt)
    #eval-item([Technical terms])
    #v(3pt)
    #eval-item([Level 1-4])
  ]
]

#let labelled-line(label) = [
  #text(size: 8.9pt, weight: "bold", fill: charcoal)[#label]
  #v(2pt)
  #write-line()
]

#let evidence-area() = [
  #text(size: 8.9pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Evidence: what did I accomplish or learn?]
  #v(4pt)
  #write-line()
  #v(8pt)
  #write-line()
  #v(8pt)
  #write-line()
]

#let daily-box(day) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 1.15in,
  stroke: 0.85pt + mist,
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 6pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (0.93fr, 1.18fr, 1.24in),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#day]
      #v(3pt)
      #labelled-line([Today's goal])
      #v(4pt)
      #labelled-line([How will I know I met it?])
      #v(4pt)
      #labelled-line([Who did I work with?])
    ],
    [#evidence-area()],
    [#evaluation-panel()]
  )
]

#brand-header([Weekly Progress Log], [Set the Goal. Follow the Way. Take Action.])
#v(4pt)
#info-row()
#v(5pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 10pt,
  align: horizon,
  [#text(size: 14.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Daily Progress]],
  [#line(length: 100%, stroke: 2.3pt + pcss-gold)]
)
#v(5pt)

#daily-box([Monday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Tuesday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Wednesday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Thursday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Friday])

#pagebreak()

#let rating-panel() = [
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    fill: pale-gold,
    stroke: 0.7pt + mist,
    radius: 3pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 5pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[SELF-RATING]
    #v(3pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto),
      column-gutter: 4pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold")[E]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold")[G]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold")[S]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold")[N]], [#check-box()],
    )
  ]
]

#let skill-row(title, prompt) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 0.91in,
  stroke: 0.85pt + mist,
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 5pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (2.45in, 1fr, 2.05in),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 10.9pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 8.4pt, fill: slate)[#prompt]
    ],
    [
      #text(size: 8.7pt, weight: "bold", fill: charcoal)[My evidence or next step]
      #v(4pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
    ],
    [#rating-panel()]
  )
]

#brand-header([Learning Skills Reflection], [How have I demonstrated and improved these learning skills?])
#v(4pt)
#info-row()
#v(4pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 4pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 4pt),
)[
  #text(size: 8.6pt, fill: slate)[E = Excellent   G = Good   S = Satisfactory   N = Needs Improvement. Use a specific example in each row.]
]
#v(5pt)

#skill-row([Responsibility], [Uses class time well, follows through, and completes agreed work without repeated reminders.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Organization], [Keeps goals, tools, materials, files, and time organized so work can move forward.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Independent Work], [Starts promptly, stays focused, uses resources, and attempts solutions before asking for help.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Collaboration], [Listens, shares tools and space, contributes fairly, and helps the group succeed.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Initiative], [Asks thoughtful questions, seeks feedback, notices what needs doing, and takes useful action.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Self-Regulation], [Manages distractions, works safely, responds to feedback, and adjusts when something is not working.])
```
